The free hand retains folded fingers and authored long pointed claws in a compact clawed silhouette, not an artificially rounded or shortened glove. No detached hand fragment is visible. The raised hand meets the web. This rear angle partly hides the palm: the improved distal clearance is supported separately by complete-hand offline comparisons, not asserted as directly visible here. Uniform 90/85 curl was rejected after offline palm penetration was found; this production asset uses 90/65 for the two original 2099 source meshes. No exhaustive contact testing is claimed.
